heading: Terms.
bodyHtml:
AppRafter the open-source project is governed by its LICENSE (FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 — see ADR 0032). This page covers terms specific to apprafter.dev.

The site

apprafter.dev is informational. No accounts, no purchases, no contracts are signed by browsing it. The site is provided “as is” without warranty.

The software

The platform code (cli, operator, schemas, manifests, platform services) is licensed under FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 and converts to plain Apache 2.0 two years after each release. You may use it for any purpose — personal, internal business, or commercial workloads — except offering AppRafter itself as a managed service to third parties during the FSL window. After two years, that restriction lifts.

The waitlist

Submitting the managed-launch waitlist form is not a contract. We send exactly one announcement email when the managed offering ships, plus one optional follow-up if you ticked the discovery-call box. You can ask us to delete the entry any time at hello@apprafter.dev.

When the formal terms ship they will replace this stub. The source of truth will move to a Payload LegalPages collection.
